# Micro-Agent Project

Micro-Agent is an AI agent system implementing ReAct logic, memory extraction, RAG, and Tool/MCP usage.

## Directory Structure
- `src/` - Application logic.
  - `src/core/` - Agent logic, prompts, memory management (Long-term, Short-term, RAG).
  - `src/coder/` - CLI interface.
  - `src/langchain_core/` & `src/langgraph/` - Mock wrappers.
- `tools/` - Callable actions by the AI.
  - `tools/mcp_servers/` - Model Context Protocol servers.
  - `tools/skills/` - Isolated agent skills.
- `data/` - Static files, e.g., knowledge bases.
- `docs/` - Architectural markdown docs.
- `tests/` - Python tests for logic verification.
- `scripts/` - Utilities for database and system state operations.

## Key Files
- `src/core/agent.py` - Core ReAct loop.
- `src/core/memory.py` & `src/core/rag.py` - Memory & retrieval algorithms.
- `tests/test_everything_agent.py` - Entry point for testing MCP loading.

## Instructions
For full guidelines on interacting with this codebase, see `AGENTS.md`.
